subject: FW: Data for your study will be deleted in 3 days
body:
Hi Hanna,

 

I received this email letting me know that my study (#4020) is being deleted. We purchased a yearlong license for this study in August and are currently collected data and are actively enrolling participants, so I am a little concerned that this project is going to be deleted. Please let me know if there is anything I need to do to prevent this from happening.

 

Thanks,

Mercedes

From: Avicenna Research <no-reply@avicennaresearch.com>
Date: Wednesday, October 2, 2024 at 1:36 AM
To: Mercedes Woolley <mercedes.woolley@usu.edu>
Subject: Data for your study will be deleted in 3 days

Data for your study will be deleted in 3 days

Hi Mercedes,

We wanted to let you know that your trial study on Avicenna Research, #4020, titled "Process-Based Therapy for Trichotillomania Study" will reset in 3 days . This means all data collected so far as part of this study will be removed.

Why my study's data is being erased?
We regularly clean up trial studies on Avicenna. Of course, you can collect new data for this study, and continue trying out Avicenna. If you would like to keep the study data, please consider purchasing a license. You can do so by contacting sales@avicennaresearch.com .

What exactly is being erased
Every data that is received from any of the participants, including sensor data, survey responses, cognitive tasks, and participant history. Currently, enrolled participants remain enrolled and can continue uploading data to your study.

How should I stop this?
If you need to keep these data in your Avicenna account, please contact sales@avicennaresearch.com and we will be able to help you acquire a license.

Thanks for using our site!
Avicenna
